package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// I18nRepoPG implements I18nRepository.
type I18nRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts i18n entry.
func (r I18nRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, entry domain.I18n) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	var err error
	if entry.ID > 0 {
		_, err = runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO i18n (id, language) VALUES ($1,$2) ON CONFLICT (language) DO NOTHING`,
			entry.ID, entry.Language)
	} else {
		_, err = runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO i18n (language) VALUES ($1) ON CONFLICT (language) DO NOTHING`,
			entry.Language)
	}
	return err
}

// GetByID finds i18n by id.
func (r I18nRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id int) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, language FROM i18n WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var i domain.I18n
	if err := row.Scan(&i.ID, &i.Language); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &i, nil
}

// GetByLanguage finds i18n by language.
func (r I18nRepoPG) GetByLanguage(ctx context.Context, language string) (*domain.I18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, language FROM i18n WHERE language=$1`, language)
	var i domain.I18n
	if err := row.Scan(&i.ID, &i.Language); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &i, nil
}

// List returns all i18n entries.
func (r I18nRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.I18n, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `SELECT id, language FROM i18n ORDER BY language`)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var res []domain.I18n
	for rows.Next() {
		var i domain.I18n
		if err := rows.Scan(&i.ID, &i.Language); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		res = append(res, i)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return res, nil
}

var _ repository.I18nRepository = (*I18nRepoPG)(nil)
